# Bridge ops

Ops a frontend-only Kiwi App can invoke through the window proxy
(`kiwi:apiRequest`). The host makes the real call with the app token, so your
app needs no token and no CORS entry.

| Op | Endpoint | Scopes | App params |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contextualChat` | `POST /api/kiwi-apps/{slug}/contextual-chat` | `context:student_learning:read` + `llm:prompt:{promptId}` | promptId, userMessage, contextRequest, outputSchema |
| `documentChunks` | `GET /api/kiwi-apps/classes/{classId}/document-chunks` | `class:materials:chunks:read` | documentIds, cursor, limit |

### `contextualChat`

Run an approved prompt over the student's private learning context

- **Endpoint:** `POST /api/kiwi-apps/{slug}/contextual-chat`
- **Scopes:** `context:student_learning:read` + `llm:prompt:{promptId}`
- **Host-injected params:** `slug` (from appSlug) — the app cannot set these.
- **App-token only:** yes
- **Timeout:** 120000 ms
- **SDK:** `await kiwi.contextualChat({ … })`

### `documentChunks`

Get parsed document text chunks for a class

- **Endpoint:** `GET /api/kiwi-apps/classes/{classId}/document-chunks`
- **Scopes:** `class:materials:chunks:read`
- **Host-injected params:** `classId` (from classId) — the app cannot set these.
- **App-token only:** no
- **Timeout:** 30000 ms
- **SDK:** `await kiwi.documentChunks({ … })`
